name: Netting Cut Off Reference Data Update Request V 02
definition: The Netting Cut Off Reference Data Update Request message is sent to a central system by a participant to request an update to a participant's netting cut off held at the central system.

RequestData.name: Request Data
RequestData.definition: Specifies the meta data for the netting cut off update request.

NettingCutOffRequest.name: Netting Cut Off Request
NettingCutOffRequest.definition: Specifies the information regarding the changes to the netting cut off.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
